facts.fact: Jehan 拒绝提前拆读 Ysabel 的信，坚持要通过考试，而且要以无人能指摘的方式完成
facts.anchor: we pass the exam, and we do it in a way nobody can argue with

facts.fact: Jehan 对尸体保管人谎称 Moyna 与死去的 Ysabel 是秘密情人，以此获准进入尸体房
facts.anchor: Moyna and the scholar who’d died had been secret lovers

facts.fact: Moyna 发现 Ysabel 颅骨破裂、硬膜下有陈旧血块，但那里没有魔法，只是创伤
facts.anchor: beneath the cracked skull. No magic, just trauma.

facts.fact: Moyna 在 Ysabel 心脏里发现魔法，味道像酸黑莓、刺感像廉价羊毛
Decroy 的喉咙被割开，但 Moyna 发现他心脏里同样有魔法围绕心房
facts.anchor: the same in the heart: magic around the atria

facts.fact: 作为对照，Moyna 检查数年前死于 burnout 的 Healer Francessa Loile：Loile 为救两名从海里捞起、近乎溺死的孩子而死，体内魔法到处都是、微弱而腐朽
facts.anchor: died of burnout while attempting to heal two children pulled near-drowned from the sea

facts.fact: Moyna 向 Thoury 承认她与 Ysabel 并非情人，并说明自己往尸体里送了治疗魔法；Thoury 问她心脏周围的魔法是否可能致死，她答是
facts.anchor: “Magic around her heart?” he asked when she was done. “Could that have killed her?”

facts.fact: Thoury 私下问 Moyna 是否愿意来为他工作
facts.anchor: if you would like to come and work for me?
